verdicts.reason: Both lose the hero: the Solstice can, which carries the brand, is shrunk to a tiny icon jammed into the bottom-left corner. The glow circle is split off from it and sits empty, the Shop Now button awkwardly overlaps that circle, and a large blank gradient panel fills the middle of the canvas. A also places the logo at an odd right-of-centre spot that doesn't line up with the left-aligned headline. B centres the logo and keeps steadier margins, but its can is even smaller, so it is only marginally less broken.
